company.name: Syarah
company.shortDescription: Syarah is an online platform in Saudi Arabia that lets users buy new or used cars, handle paperwork, insurance, and delivery, all digitally.
company.description:
Syarah specializes in promoting the sale of used and new cars online, assisting businesses and individuals in purchasing their vehicles as easily and quickly as possible. The company also specializes in car financing, assisting customers in purchasing cars in installments through various banks and financing companies in Saudi Arabia and the region.

The company's goal is to provide quality services that exceed its customers' expectations.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $40,000,000, or 48.01% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,798,829 to $253,933,634, a 66.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
